outputs.explanation: Panel A is a domain map schematic combined with western blot images; no averaged plot is shown.

Panel B shows bar charts of % HTT FT depletion and log2 elution abundance vs mIgG for each antibody. These appear to be single-condition bar values (or averages) without any overlaid individual data points.
Panel C is a heatmap of normalized protein abundances; heatmaps are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel D is a violin plot showing the distribution of log2 enrichment ratios; violin plots already display the distribution and are exempt.
Panel E shows bar charts with mean ± SD (n=4) and individual data points overlaid as dots for Htt, F8a1, and Synj1 measurements.
Panel F shows a sequence alignment and a predicted protein structure, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G is a scatterplot comparing enrichment ratios between Q20 and Q140; scatterplots inherently show individual points and are exempt.
Panel H is a scatterplot of individual IP-MS experiments (HTT vs HAP40 abundance); scatterplots are exempt as they already show individual data.
Panel I is a PCA scatterplot of individual samples; scatterplots are exempt.
Panel J shows PCA scatterplots (per tissue) of individual samples; scatterplots are exempt.
